brief: Screening note on Southeast Asian polypropylene and HDPE price trends through 2026

sections.title: Southeast Asian Polypropylene and HDPE Price Trends (2024-2026)
questions: What were the monthly price trends for polypropylene (PP) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE) in Southeast Asia from January 2024 to August 2026?
Were there any notable periods of price volatility, sustained increases, or declines for either product?
Are there any documented explanations for major price movements in this period?
sections.tool_rationale: The price series provides the quantitative monthly price trends for PP and HDPE, while searching documents can reveal commentary or explanations for significant price changes or volatility.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the price series for PP or HDPE in Southeast Asia is missing or has major gaps for the 2024-2026 period, or if no documents discuss price movements or context.

excluded.topic: Price forecast or outlook for PP and HDPE after August 2026
excluded.reason: The price series and documents only cover up to August 2026, and the corpus explicitly states that forecasts or outlooks are not published.
